summary: Preserve monotonic ordered membership state across projection rebuild and heal

replay.detail: Every membership projection rebuild records the current host-local store frontier before replacing derived rows. Exposed membership state takes the maximum of its count-row index, repair watermark and rebuild watermark, so replaying older canonical claims cannot regress a lifecycle-updated frontier. Incremental and replayed shared authority remain identical.

schema.detail: Adds local_ordered_membership_rebuild_index bookkeeping to the existing local meta table. No table, index, numeric database schema version or shared projection layout changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules remain version 14. The local rebuild frontier is excluded from shared projection digests and checkpoint witnesses; no retention or drop policy changes.

compatibility.detail: No wire models, generated clients, capability versions or pairing scopes change. The existing opaque host-local monotonic membership frontier now retains its promised meaning across rebuild and heal.

downtime.detail: No additional replay or startup migration is required. An existing projection rebuild performs one transactional local meta upsert before clearing and rebuilding derived membership rows.

manual.detail: No manual data migration is required. The required v1 placement migration and exclusive reader/writer cutover remain in the follow-up stacked PR above #1958.

recovery.detail: No new recovery procedure is introduced. Rebuild/heal preserves the host-local invalidation frontier without treating it as canonical revision, cross-host ordering or checkpoint authority.
